name: zincbank-test-framework
description: Playwright + Cucumber BDD UI automation framework

scripts.test: cucumber-js --profile default; code=$?; npm run report:rtm -- 'npm test'; exit $code
scripts.test:smoke: cucumber-js --profile smoke; code=$?; npm run report:rtm -- 'npm run test:smoke'; exit $code
scripts.test:regression: cucumber-js --profile regression; code=$?; npm run report:rtm -- 'npm run test:regression'; exit $code
scripts.signup: cucumber-js --profile signup; code=$?; npm run report:rtm -- 'npm run signup'; exit $code
